title: Verify: Boy sheet frame count, size and palette unit tests
description: Test frame count, per-frame size and palette use from the REQ1 spec.

steps.action: Create tests importing BOY_SHEET_SOURCE and PALETTE. Test 'has 14 frames' expects frames.length 14; test 'each frame is 48 rows by 32 columns' loops frames; test 'uses only palette indices' flattens every grid and asserts Number.isInteger(v) && v>=0 && v<PALETTE.length; test 'idle, walk and interact frames differ' asserts frame 0 != frame 4 != frame 10 via JSON.stringify.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/boySheet.test.ts
